theme_archetype.description: Blends high-contrast modern functionality (Blinkit/Myntra) with organic trust and fashion elegance (Nykaa). Emphasizes speed, local credibility, and high-conversion layouts.

color_palette_bridge.strategy: Transition from muted cream/navy to crisp white/deep navy for a more performance-focused, modern feel while keeping the brand equity.

scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-display font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.caption: text-xs font-sans text-slate-500

skeleton_rules.behavior: Match exact dimensions of final loaded element to prevent layout shift.

mobile_homepage_hero.description: Full-bleed image or split card. FIXED copy over dark gradient overlay (bg-black/40). Dual gender CTAs (Shop Women/Men) side-by-side. Metric strip floats at the very bottom overlapping the next section: '4.8 Avg Rating · 50+ Verified Stores · 5,000+ Products · 2,000+ Deliveries'.

mobile_product_card.description: 80% image top, 20% content bottom. Image aspect-[4/5]. ONE dynamic badge top-left (absolute). Wishlist heart top-right (absolute). Bottom content: Brand, Title (truncate-1), Price (bold) + strikethrough + discount %, ETA/Delivery note.

mobile_store_card.description: Banner image top (h-24). Rounded logo overlapping banner bottom edge. Below banner: Store Name, Verified badge, Rating + Reviews, 'Since 2017', Distance, ETA. Bottom row: 1-line store story or social proof.

mobile_pdp_above_fold.description: Image carousel (aspect-[3/4]). Urgency strip immediately below image. Title, Price, Discount. Doorstep Trial chip. Size selector chips. Trust strip (Secure/COD/Returns).

mobile_sticky_bottom_nav.description: Fixed bottom, z-50, bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md, border-t. 5 items: Home, Categories, Search, Orders, Profile. Active state uses Accent Orange.

mobile_search_overlay.description: Full screen modal. Header with Back button and thick Search Input. Input features rotating placeholder text. Below: 'Trending Searches' chips, 'Recent Searches' list.

what_to_avoid: No generic full-screen gradients. Keep backgrounds crisp white.
No stacked badges on product cards (strictly ONE per card).
No fake numbers or placeholder stats (all must be agent-driven).
No excessive motion or parallax that hurts performance.
No off-brand colors (stick strictly to Navy, Orange, White, Slate).
